content:
António Aguiar Costa, R&D Director of BUILT CoLAB, will be one of the invited speakers at the 11th Session of the Cycle of Reflections and Debates organized by the Portuguese Association of Librarians, Archivists, Information and Documentation Professionals (ADB), which takes place on June 16, at 6 pm.

This session will be dedicated to the engineering and architecture archives and António Aguiar Costa will address the theme of bim methodology. The session will also have the participation of Paulo Batista (Lisbon City Council), archivist with phD on the architectural archives.

See here details of the event and learn how to register.
